roll.title: Voter roll update
roll.intro: Bring a new voter roll (final roll, revised draft, supplementary list) into an assembly that is already in the system. Everything the party has entered stays.

plan.howTitle: How the numbers are worked out
plan.how:
Expected votes = electors on today's roll × turnout (each booth's turnout last time, or the turnout you type in).
Target share = the best rival's share last time + safety margin (or the target you type in). Swing needed = target share − our share last time; each booth's target = our share there last time + that swing.
Votes we have now = survey supporters × supporter turnout + not-surveyed voters × turnout × our share there last time.
Gap = votes needed − votes we have now. Can still be won = neutral voters and the rest of the not-surveyed voters who are expected to vote.
Winnable: the gap is smaller than what can still be won. Tough: it is bigger. On track: no gap. Safe: 15% or more above the target.

settings.s.scan_enabled: Scan voter card / slip with the camera
settings.h.scan_enabled: Adds a camera button to voter search, the offline field app and poll-day marking. Reads the barcode on voter slips, the QR code on new voter cards, or the printed EPIC number. Read on the phone itself (nothing is sent anywhere); works without internet once used. Voter slips get a barcode.
